title: The Fortress Wall
subtitle: Be inside the structure
description: The fortress keeps its own weather: corridors that all look like
the way out, and a stair that only goes where the walls agree.
Stand inside `minecraft:fortress` and the task knows it -- the
second structure task in the collection, after the drowned
cathedral, and the two of them together are the whole idea: the
game's own landmarks, used as quest gates.
